description: This file defines several reusable UI primitive React components, including a loading indicator, error message block, empty state, and status chip, with accessible ARIA attributes and minimal styling.

methods.name: LoadingState
methods.description: A loading indicator component with ARIA live updates and minimalist styling.

methods.name: ErrorState
methods.description: An accessible error message block with icon, title, message, and optional action.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: A semantic empty state component with title, description, and optional action.

methods.name: StatusChip
methods.description: A status indicator chip with green, amber, or red semantics, including accessible labels.
